title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle: vendor RKE2 support for Rocky / AlmaLinux + rollback tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add support for shipping an offline airgap bundle that includes vendored RKE2 artifacts and init scripts validated on Rocky Linux 9 and AlmaLinux 9. This enables customers running RKE2 on RHEL-compatible distros to install Redwood Private in air-gapped environments without upstream mirrors.

What this PR does: 
- Adds a new offline bundle generator target (bundles/rke2-rhel-compatible) that packages rke2 binaries, OS packages (rpm), containerd images, Helm charts, and TUF metadata.
- Vendored runtime artifacts: rke2 binaries, rke2-kubernetes nodes images, containerd snapshots and systemd unit templates.
- Apt/yum mirror helper scripts and an optional local repo layout to support 9.x RHEL-compatible kernels and kmods.
- Terraform module updates to expose bundle source and checksum verification for private-installer deployment automation.
- Helm chart updates to include platform affinity and node taints for RKE2 role separation.
- Rollback tooling: add snapshot-based rollback script that can restore cluster manifests and preflight asset state from a bundle snapshot.
- TUF signing integration: automated metadata generation and verification hooks used during bundle produce/consume.
- Docs: installation guide additions and troubleshooting for RKE2 on Rocky/AlmaLinux.

Checklist:
- [x] Bundle generator target added and tested locally on Rocky/AlmaLinux 9.
- [x] Terraform module input/output compatibility preserved.
- [x] Helm chart lint and smoke deploy to kind + rke2 test cluster.
- [x] TUF metadata generation and local verification.
- [x] Added unit tests for bundle manifest parsing and checksum validation.
- [x] Updated docs and quickstart.

Notes on compatibility: This change is additive for other installers (k3s/rke2-flatcar/ubuntu) and does not remove existing bundle targets. Consumers using the terraform module must supply the bundle_url and bundle_checksum when deploying in air-gapped mode.

Testing performed: 
- End-to-end bundle produce -> transfer -> consume on an isolated VM running Rocky 9 (KVM) and an air-gapped RKE2 cluster (v1.26) with our private-installer.
- CI: helm lint, terraform fmt & validate, unit tests for bundle manifest, integration smoke test on a small rke2 lab cluster (non-airgap).

Related: ENG-9123 (bundle roadmap), SUP-1432 (customer case), docs PR will follow for step-by-step airgap transfer examples.
